scientific_question: Can an official iShares historical endpoint recover exact 2024 IBIT Shares Outstanding observations in a cutoff-safe form without accessing current/protected holdings?

parsing_contract.requested_date_binding: The raw provider payload must explicitly contain the requested date in YYYY-MM-DD, YYYYMMDD, or a provider-native human-readable date that resolves exactly to the requested date.
parsing_contract.shares_field: The payload must contain an explicit provider-native field/row naming Shares Outstanding (case/space/punctuation normalized only) with a positive numeric value.
forbidden_substitutes: derived shares from price or assets
parsing_contract.fail_closed: No inferred date or inferred shares value.

retained_diagnostics: sanitized first 300 text characters for failing payloads only
numeric Shares Outstanding value for exact 2024 probe dates only
stop_rule: If no official route passes the frozen exact-date/explicit-shares gate, stop. Do not substitute holdings, AUM, third-party flow data, current snapshots, or protected-period workbook history.
